cover.line: Every room I ever built started on this paper.

notes: corner stays open → people walk in, not past
red = the brand. everything else stays quiet
a tree in the middle, kids run around it
mud walls, real lanterns, real coffee
built to look old on day one
one ribbon, folded until it stands
the screen sits where the fold opens
glass + brass. let the light engrave it
opens like a gift, kept like a secret

hand.title: What's in my hand
tools: the first ten minutes of every room
cheap, so I can waste it
every plan, every logo, every sign
moves: the brief, the venue, the audience. mostly the audience.
one page. if the page works, the room will.
every wall, cable and sightline before a screw.
doors open. I watch faces, not screens.

lines: Twenty years ago I drew for a bookshop in Lebanon.
Then ten years of broadcast motion, 2D and 3D, for TV.
Then Riyadh, and events, where a render on Monday is a street on Friday.
Now I lead creative at Sovyal Events. I still draw first.
People say I am the loud one in the room. The work is the quiet one.

contact.line: Tell me the date and the room. I'll draw the rest.
